verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open engine published as npm packages under the Apache-2.0 license, so users can install, bundle and serve the core library on their own infrastructure. Server-side use is also documented through the NullEngine. missing for 10: explicit first-party self-hosting guidance, evidence that the hosted tools (Playground, Node Material Editor, Sandbox) can be self-hosted, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: `npm view @babylonjs/core version` → 9.26.1 (Apache-2.0, 234,040 weekly downloads via the public npm API)
Babylon.js is a powerful, beautiful, simple, and open game and rendering engine
